header.title: Position
header.subtitle: place the text on the 8 axes -- the coordinates of the mind that made it
header.output: Morphospace (the position read as a space texts sit in)
header.grain: passage-level (keyed by passage_id, NOT source_key -- the Seam-2 key)

pills.fidelity: PARTIAL -- golden path clean; corpus-wide drift (now caught)
pills.vs_wild: PASS (floor) -- covers the naive read + adds rigor; atlas under-weights fear (noted)

header.status_line: Position places a text on 8 axes; on Mark 16 it is clean -- 26 placements across 8 of 8 axes, all in-vocab. Its vocab renders LIVE from exom_axis_vocabulary (never hardcoded), which is why it is the calibration model. Honest limit: corpus-wide (57235 placements across many texts), 0 axis/value pairs drifted off-vocab WITHOUT a fit-or-extend candidate; the S163 drift-check now catches it. So: golden path clean, corpus drift named.

what_it_is: Position reads a whole passage and places it on eight axes -- the coordinates of the mind that produced it: how it knows (epistemic-warrant), what it takes to be real (ontological-commitment), how it reasons (inferential-operation), what end it seeks (telos), its attitude (evaluative-stance), how it interprets (hermeneutic-posture), and the shape + terms of the ground<->world relation (r_topology, r_condition). The eight coordinates ARE the text's position in the Morphospace.
why_it_matters: A Position placement is what lets two texts be COMPARED as points in one space rather than argued about impressionistically. It is also where an absence shows: an axis a text does NOT engage (the not-engaged sentinel) is a real, coded fact -- a mind that never asks the ontological question is telling you something. The morphospace is the map convergence and divergence are read off.

how_it_works.the_method_does: one atlas-reader pass places the passage on each of the 8 axes onto the ESTABLISHED vocab (fit-or-extend: propose a new value if none fits), with a confidence per value, a membership weight where a real compound splits an axis, and an explicit not-engaged when the axis does not apply.
how_it_works.you_get_back: the 8-axis coordinate (a placement per axis-value) + any proposed candidates, joined to the passage.

pipeline_context.note: sibling terms glossed so the card stands alone.
pipeline_context.move: one small action a text makes (agent does an operation to something, with a result) -- the unit the pipeline codes.
pipeline_context.Decompose: the node that breaks a passage into moves; Position (in Situate) runs alongside it.
pipeline_context.Situate: the parent node: attaches context to each move; Position is its coordinates aspect.
pipeline_context.Morphospace: the output Position feeds: the 8 axes read as a space; each text is a point, distances are comparisons.
pipeline_context.fit-or-extend: the vocab discipline (s2.1 = cast wide, do not pre-anchor): pick from the established values; if none fits, PROPOSE a candidate (never force-fit).
pipeline_context.the candidate log: atlas_frame_read_candidate -- where a proposed new value (or a probed 9th axis) is recorded for review.
pipeline_context.not-engaged: an explicit sentinel placement: this axis does NOT apply to this text (so zero is provably distinct from a missed read). NOT the same as the ontological value 'not-asserted' (a real placement).
pipeline_context.passage_id: the atlas's key -- Position is keyed by passage_id, not source_key (resolve via text_checkout, the crosswalk from a text to its passages).
pipeline_context.Seam-2: the failure this card guards against: reading a text on ONE key while its data sits under a sibling key (a key-scatter false-negative). Position's is passage_id, not source_key.
pipeline_context.usage-driven inclusion: the vocab is NOT a green/candidate approval gate (that framing is retired) -- a value belongs to an axis by how often it is actually PLACED across the corpus; the dictionary orders values by use-count.
pipeline_context.emergent-via-use: values the reader has PLACED but that are not yet settled in the set (surfacing through use); the CRT's worklist to add / merge / hold.
pipeline_context.R1-R5: the atlas reader's coding rubric (Decision 201): R5 = exactly the 8 axes; R1-R4 govern how richly + honestly each placement is coded. Not a reliability grade.
pipeline_context.PI: the principal investigator (the researcher) -- who locks methodology calls.

how_we_grade_it.Fidelity: mechanical: does every placement value map to a LIVE vocab value, or (fit-or-extend) a logged candidate? A value that is NEITHER is silent drift.
how_we_grade_it.Cold Read: self-sufficiency: a blind reader judges whether the card explains itself.
how_we_grade_it.vs-Wild: does the atlas placement beat a naive reader given only the passage + 'place it on these 8 axes'? (owed).
how_we_grade_it.result_categories: INCOMPLETE / FAIL / PARTIAL (golden clean, corpus drift) / PASS.

the_method_clean.note: the 8 axes (definitions), each with its vocab rendered LIVE from the canonical field dictionary (DATA_atlas_field_dictionary.json): values ordered BY USAGE, each with its own definition + use-count, plus the emergent-via-use worklist (values surfacing through use, not yet settled). The card never hardcodes the lists, and cannot diverge from the Librarian-owned dictionary.

axes.gloss: how the text KNOWS / grounds its claims (E)

values_by_usage.definition: Someone else tells you. The warrant is mediated: it rests on a living witness who saw, and the knower is not the one who did.
It is disclosed. A truth given from outside the natural order, received passively, with no procedure of interpretation standing between the source and the knower.

It has been handed down. The warrant is inheritance: the claim is licensed because a tradition, community, or institution holds and transmits it, not because any single living witness saw it. Covers received tradition, communal consensus (ijma, sangha), and institutional authority.
You see it yourself. Direct, unmediated sensory access, with no witness between the knower and the known.
It follows. The warrant is inferential: the claim is licensed by argument, not by access.
Known through doing it. The warrant is the disciplined activity itself: repeated performance is what makes the claim evident, independent of any bodily skill acquired.
Direct intellectual apprehension. The truth is grasped whole, without inference and without sensory mediation.
Known in the body. The warrant is tacit, non-propositional bodily competence: a trained skill or attunement that can be demonstrated but not fully stated.
Known by reading a sign. The truth is solicited through a procedure (casting, omens, consulting an oracle); a technique of interpretation stands between the knower and the answer.
Known by becoming one with the object. The knower and the known collapse into one.

axes.gloss: what it takes to be REAL / the kind of being it assumes (O)

values_by_usage.definition: A personal will is fundamental. What is most real is someone, an agent with intention, not an impersonal stuff or law.
Matter is fundamental. What is most real is physical stuff; everything else is its arrangement.

Reality is constituted through relations of PARTICIPATION — beings are neither identical with ultimate reality (union) nor merely separate substances (dualism/pluralism), but partake in it. Distinct from the substance-based ontology values. Home cases: theosis (2 Peter 1:4, partakers of the divine nature), Ibn Arabi tajalli, Neoplatonic emanation/methexis.
The passage takes no ontological position. It is about ethics or practice and simply does not address what is fundamental. A passive absence.
Flux is fundamental. What is most real is events and becoming, not fixed things.
An impersonal order is fundamental. The ground is a law or pattern, not an agent.
Awareness is fundamental. Mind is not produced by matter; matter is a content of mind. Mind is the single ground, not a property distributed through things.
Two or more irreducible kinds are fundamental; no single substance grounds the rest.

The passage actively refuses to commit and holds the refusal as its position. Requires an explicit refusal-marker in the text (this cannot be said; one neither affirms nor denies); absent that marker, code not-asserted.
The ground is beyond all predication. It cannot be said to be substance, process, or even empty; the fundamental is unsayable.

axes.gloss: how it REASONS / the move from premise to conclusion (I)

values_by_usage.definition: Explains by cause and effect: the conclusion is reached by identifying what produces what.
Deduces from premises already accepted: the conclusion follows necessarily from first principles, regardless of where those principles came from (even if scriptural).
Draws the conclusion out of an authoritative text. Bound to recovering a specific source meaning.
Advances by negation: the conclusion emerges from setting a claim against its contradiction.
Transfers structure from one domain to another: A is to B as C is to D. The conclusion rides on the likeness.
Generalises from instances: many observed cases license a claim about the unobserved.
Infers the best explanation: from a surprising fact, reasons back to what would, if true, make it a matter of course.

axes.gloss: the END it is oriented toward / what fulfillment is (T)

values_by_usage.definition: Rescue and restoration. Something is wrong or broken, and a right relation is put back.
Obedience, duty, worship, preservation. The marker: the end is not the agent own benefit.
Understanding is the end, not the warrant for something else.
Emancipation or reform of a shared world. The end is collective and external, not individual release.
The actualisation of persons: a life going well in its own terms.
Right order among parts. The end is the structural relation among many, not a bond with any single one.
Release. Something binds (craving, ignorance, bondage, structure) and is loosed. The end is freedom from, not the repair of a relation.
The aim of ongoing membership and acceptance — having a PLACE with an other or a group, WITHOUT merger (covenant, family, tradition). Distinct from communion (union) and salvation (rescue).
Love, union, belonging. The end is a dyadic bond with an other.
Capability as an end in itself, not as a means.
Regards the object as sacred or authoritative: approached with deference and awe, as something that may make a claim on the reader.
Regards the object without evaluative commitment: describes it without endorsing, discounting, deferring to, or suspecting it.
Approaches the object with warmth, care, and protective gentleness — a cherishing, vulnerable regard (distinct from reverent=awe and charitable=good-faith).
Regards the object as owed good faith: reads for the strongest available sense. An interpretive default, not deference to authority.
Approaches the object as something to resist or stand against — an oppositional posture (Job before God; a prophet before power; a liberation text before authority).
Regards the object as withholding something: reads for what it does not say.

The text's posture toward its object is ironic — it means other than, or against, what it literally says; a detached or subverting attitude. DISTINCT from a stated contradiction (B1 gap-irony) and from an audience-character knowledge gap (Sitz dramatic-irony): this is the STANCE layer only. See three_layer_irony_distinction_s157.

axes.gloss: how it HANDLES / interprets its object (S2)

values_by_usage.definition: The surface grammatical sense is the meaning. The text means what it plainly says; no hidden layer, symbol, or subtext is sought. A claim about semantic depth, not a refusal to interpret.
The surface plus. Reads generously, assembles, repairs, seeks what the text can be made to sustain.
Treats the text as an ACT to be enacted/performed (ritual, liturgical, legal, dramatic, sung) — its meaning is in the DOING, not only the interpreting.
The surface hides a mechanism. Digs beneath the text for the real cause or interest it does not declare.

axes.gloss: the SHAPE of the ground<->world relation (creation / emanation / dependent-arising / differentiation / enmeshment / exclusion)

values_by_usage.definition: Parties occupy unequal positions; authority or permission flows predominantly one way.
An A-B relation constituted or stabilised through a third position, object, rule, symbol or witness.
Irreversible origination plus mutual obligation flowing in opposite directions; the child chooses the obligation.

A party utters, in the first person, words commissioned by an absent principal. The third lends a mouth so an absent party's own voice reaches the addressee — a conduit for VOICE, not a position that stabilises.
An asymmetric holding: one party acts on behalf of, or carries responsibility for, another. A POSITION occupied, not a goal pursued.
A party positioned outside a boundary of membership, protection or recognition. The scapegoat position.
Things are real in proportion to how fully they share in the ground. It is about degree of sharing, not rank of level and not identity.
A one-time passage that permanently changes what the parties are to each other.
Two parties positioned as competitors for something that cannot be simultaneously possessed.
Living, dead and unborn held as one topology across time; asymmetric yet binding.

axes.gloss: the TERMS/mode of that relation (covenantal / compassionate-resonance / companionship / hierarchical-guidance / disengagement)

values_by_usage.definition: A freely undertaken bond generating durable, asymmetric-but-reciprocal obligations that persist despite failure.
Asymmetry in which one guides, teaches, or carries responsibility for another.
A bond that still exists and is severed. Not the instant of breaking — the sustained condition of being broken while still bound.
A bond maintained through inherited ties across generations; moral permanence.
The shape is set by what comportment is appropriate to this particular other.
One party holds privileged knowledge of the relation's actual state and transfers it to correct another's mistaken belief about it. The bond is altered EPISTEMICALLY rather than by deed.
Asymmetric effort toward mending: provisional trust, testing, restitution. Presupposes a prior whole.
An originating gift, perpetual gratitude, and an asymmetric indebtedness never fully discharged.
An asymmetric opening of a boundary that receives the other without dissolving the distinction between them.
Shaped by shared suffering plus an active urge to alleviate it.

field_contract.note: OPEN; the warrant + the reader's uncertainty

the_method_clean.live_vocab_rule: Position is THE model for the live-vocab rule: axis + value render from the canonical field dictionary (DATA_atlas_field_dictionary.json), so the drawer cannot go stale or diverge from it. Inclusion is USAGE-DRIVEN (how often a value is actually placed), not a green/candidate approval gate; the reader may surface a new value (fit-or-extend), which must be logged -- the S163 drift-check enforces that discipline (Layer 3).

the_method_applied.note: Mark 16 placed on the 8 axes (render-from-data). Each axis shows the coded value(s), whether it is the primary placement, confidence, the evidence snippet, and the value's live vocab status. Mark 16 spans 2 passages (its passage_ids), so an axis can carry two primary placements -- one per passage, not a duplicate.

where_saved.plain: Placements save to atlas_frame_read_placement, keyed by passage_id (resolve the text's passages via text_checkout). The vocab lives in exom_axis_vocabulary (the live controlled set); proposed values live in atlas_frame_read_candidate. Read at passage grain, never by source_key.

honest_limits: CORPUS-WIDE VOCAB DRIFT. 462 distinct off-vocab (axis,value) pairs are written in placements but NOT in exom_axis_vocabulary; only 462 off-vocab values were logged as fit-or-extend candidates, so 0 are SILENT drift (a value written without its candidate). Position's axis/value are free-text by design (fit-or-extend), so there is no DB CHECK -- the S163 drift-check (atlas_frame_vocab_drift_check.py) is the Layer-3 backstop that now catches this. Reconciling the drift (triage candidates into the vocab; backfill candidate rows) is the LIBRARIAN SB's job -- the Librarian owns the atlas reader and will own the vocab table + definitions (PI, S163); this drift-check hands it to them. (462 = 0 silent + 462 candidate).
GOLDEN PATH IS CLEAN. On Mark 16 all 26 placements map to a live vocab value (green or candidate); 0 silent drift. So the drift is on OTHER texts, not the worked example.
POSITION IS PASSAGE-LEVEL, not per-move. The grain rule intends per-move Position too (each move its own coordinates), but that needs Decompose to stamp passage_id per move; not populated yet.
vs-Wild is OWED: give a naive reader the passage + 'place it on these 8 axes' and compare to the atlas placement. Cold Read is owed on this card. Both are the next checks.
3109 of the candidate log's rows are 9th-AXIS probes (R4 completeness test), pending review -- an open question whether the 8 axes are collectively exhaustive.

One honest nuance: the atlas slightly UNDER-WEIGHTS the fear/rebuke affect (evaluative-stance reverent/tender skews warm vs the empty tomb's terror-that-silences) -- a coding note routed to the Librarian's atlas, not a card defect.
